## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: key regime ratios listed as NEUTRAL (VXX NEUTRAL, SPY_TLT NEUTRAL) and credit proxies HYG/LQD show only marginal gains (HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND) supporting a neutral tape.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit slightly easier: HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND → marginal improvement. Volatility labelled neutral in regime signals (VXX listed NEUTRAL) but VXX detailed shows weakness; treat fear as mixed and monitor VXX.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-stable: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY ↑ rising while TLT (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND → flat, and UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +2.71%) — no clear directional tilt.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Selective cyclicals and momentum leading: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +6.62%) ABOVE TREND. Tech showing short-term bounce: XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY; Financials mixed: XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities mixed: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY while EM outperformance pocketed by EEM (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND; China weak: FXI (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows uneven: ARKK (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.38%) RECOVERY and IWM (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +3.70%) ABOVE TREND signal risk-on internals, but crypto weak with IBIT (1W: -5.72% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodities under pressure: GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -21.75%) BELOW TREND; copper showing short recovery: CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND and oil ETFs BNO (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND / USO (1W: -4.33% | 1M: -17.55%) BELOW TREND; natural gas a bounce: UNG (1W: +1.91% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND show consistent strength. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY, XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION indicate 1W/1M mismatches across core ETFs, supporting the NEUTRAL verdict.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective cyclicals and momentum exposure (XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging commodities and crypto (GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND; IBIT (1W: -5.72% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Biotech XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and Semis SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND and Energy XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND on current flows.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial complex CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY for cyclicals. BEARISH: Oil (BNO (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND) and precious metals GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND remain under pressure.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (vol complacency/watch), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit-health pivot), XLK/XLF crossover ~1.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Major 1W/1M divergences across SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY, XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION are the key risks to monitor.
